closeToTray.unavailable: No system tray in this desktop session

startup.note: Closing or quitting the app doesn’t disconnect the VPN.

android.summary: Always-on VPN and Block connections without VPN are set in Android.
android.addTileManually: Open Quick Settings, tap Edit and add SirinVPN.

quickServer.label: Quick Settings server
quickServer.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the Quick Settings server.

notifications.title: Notifications & interface
notifications.infoDesktop: Alerts never include server names, addresses or keys.
notifications.infoAndroid: Alerts never include server names, addresses or keys. Android controls the ongoing VPN notification.

connection.label: Connection notifications
connection.summary: Alerts when the VPN connects, drops or reconnects

notifications.blockedAndroid: Notifications are blocked for SirinVPN in Android. Allow them in notification settings; until then, control the VPN from the app or its Quick Settings tile.

animations.label: Interface animations
animations.summary: Page transitions; your system’s reduced motion still applies

theme.label: Theme
theme.summary: System follows your device’s light or dark setting

notifications.testNeedsNotifications: Turn on connection notifications to send a test.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked for SirinVPN. Allow them in system settings to get connection alerts.

component.title: Local VPN component
component.summary: Keep this device’s VPN service matched to the app

preferences.saveFailed: Couldn’t save this setting. Your previous choice still applies.
preferences.testSent: Test notification sent; check system settings if it doesn’t appear.
preferences.notificationsUnknown: Couldn’t confirm notification access. Try again, or allow notifications for SirinVPN in system settings.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi auto-connect
wifi.infoDesktop: Trusted Wi-Fi is an exception to auto-connect, not a safety rating. Wi-Fi names are only displayed, never saved or sent. Auto-connect runs while the app is in the tray and stops when you quit.

toggle.label: Auto-connect on Wi-Fi
toggle.summary: Uses the server below, except on trusted Wi-Fi

server.label: Auto-connect server
server.offHint: Turn on auto-connect to choose its server.

status.waitingForWifi: Waiting for Wi-Fi that isn’t trusted.
status.trusted: On trusted Wi-Fi. An active VPN stays connected.
status.sessionActive: The VPN or kill switch is already on.
status.paused: Paused on this network until it changes. You can still connect manually.
status.needsAttention: Auto-connect couldn’t finish. Connect from Home to see why.
status.needsAuthorization: Connect once from Home to allow auto-connect.

access.unidentified: This Wi-Fi can’t be identified reliably, so it can’t be trusted.
access.changed: The network changed. Check its name before trusting it.
access.changedUnnamed: The network changed, and this device doesn’t report its name. Check in your system’s Wi-Fi settings which network you’re on before trusting it.

trust.label: Label (optional)
trust.trusted: {{name}} is now trusted. Auto-connect skips it.

trusted.title: Trusted Wi-Fi
trusted.label: Label: {{label}}
trusted.namesHidden: This device didn’t share Wi-Fi names. On Windows, turning on location access shows them.

credentials.title: Credential storage
credentials.summary: Applies to new keys. Existing keys stay where they are until you move them.

policy.secure: New keys must use the system keyring.
policy.fileAllowed: New keys may use an unencrypted file if the keyring is unavailable.

credentials.consent: I accept unencrypted key files when the keyring is unavailable
credentials.pendingCleanup: Some removed keys are still on this device. Unlock the keyring and retry cleanup.
credentials.loadFailed: Couldn’t read the credential storage setting.

recovery.title: Owner recovery
recovery.summary: Regain Owner access if every Owner device is lost
recovery.info: On a new device, choose Add server → Recovery key. No other Owner device or VPN connection is needed, only access to your server.
recovery.unsupported: Update the server software to use recovery keys.
recovery.registered: A recovery key is set up.
recovery.cannotIssue: Only the Owner, and Admins the Owner chose for Admin recovery, can create a recovery key.
recovery.finishing: Finishing the previous recovery key… This page checks again on its own.
recovery.accept: I understand that anyone with this key can replace every Owner device. A new key voids the old one.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke recovery key?
revokeConfirm.message: Saved copies of this key stop working immediately.

admins.title: Admin recovery
admins.summary: Selected Admins can issue a new Owner recovery key at any time. A completed recovery clears this list.
admins.none: No Admins yet, so Admin recovery is off.

confirm.title: Update Admin recovery?
confirm.message: Allow {{names}} to issue Owner recovery keys? Other Admins lose this permission.

confirmNone.title: Turn off Admin recovery?
confirmNone.message: No Admin will be able to issue Owner recovery keys.

key.warning: Store this key offline now. It works once and can’t be shown again after you finish setup.
key.label: Recovery key
key.copied: Recovery key copied. Store it offline before you finish.
key.saved: Recovery key file saved. Keep its password somewhere else.
key.retained: I’ve stored this key or the recovery key file offline and can reach it
key.finished: Done. The key is no longer shown here.
key.title: Your new recovery key

recovery.revoked: Recovery key revoked. Saved copies no longer work.

keyRotation.title: Rotate device keys
keyRotation.description: Creates new keys for this device. Its access, VPN address and name stay the same.
keyRotation.presharedKeyDescription: Creates new keys for this device, including a preshared key that keeps recorded VPN traffic private against future quantum computers. Its access, VPN address and name stay the same. Device backups exported before now stop connecting, so export a new one afterwards.

done.title: New keys are active
done.summary: Your server accepted them and the old keys were deleted from this device.

progress.summary: The VPN reconnects briefly. Keep the app open.

confirmation.title: Only this device changes
confirmation.warning: Private keys are created on this device and never sent to the server. Nothing else on the server changes.
confirmation.resumeWarning: SirinVPN kept the new keys so it can finish safely. Resume instead of removing or re-adding this server.
confirmation.accept: I understand the VPN will reconnect briefly
confirmation.acceptHint: Kill switch and auto-reconnect resume once the new keys are verified.

keyRotation.failed: Key rotation stopped safely. If it’s waiting to resume, try again once you’re online.

backup.title: Encrypted device backup
backup.description: Saves this server profile and device keys to an encrypted file. Nothing is uploaded.
backup.warning: This file can impersonate this device. Anyone with it and the password can connect until you revoke the device.

accept.label: I understand this file contains this device’s private keys
accept.hint: A lost password can’t be recovered.

done.title: Backup saved
done.summary: Keep the file and its password in separate places.

backup.pickerFailed: Couldn’t open the file picker. Try again.
backup.failed: Couldn’t create the backup. Try again.

alerts.rejectedHint: Check the address and any access token it needs.
alerts.testNeedsAddress: Save an alert address to send a test.
alerts.allowPrivateSummary: Only for a monitor on your own network or the VPN

dnsBlocking.needsList: Choose at least one blocklist to turn blocking on.

diagnostics.empty: No checks ran. Connect to this server, then run diagnostics again.
